notes.subject: mũhũmũ
notes.rationale: הבל literally breath/vapor; 'mwaki' (Kĩthwahĩri 'vanity') would lose the picture of what vanishes

notes.subject: הבל הבלים...הבל
notes.rationale: fivefold repetition with Hebrew superlative 'X of Xs' — the hammering rhythm carries the book's thesis

notes.subject: ⟨nĩ⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew has no copula; Gĩkũyũ needs 'nĩ' for 'all IS vapor'

notes.subject: Koehereti
notes.rationale: קהלת is a participle 'the assembler/lecturer', kept as a name after JPS 'Koheleth'; others render 'the Preacher/Teacher'

translation: Mũhũmũ wa mĩhũmũ, Koehereti oigĩte; mũhũmũ wa mĩhũmũ, ũndũ wothe ⟨nĩ⟩ mũhũmũ.
